invariant: A composite containing an entry or exit border point is non-autarkic and remains a live cluster in the root Graphviz graph. For the basic port branch selected when each border label's integer width is at most 40px, input points occupy the cluster's source rank, outputs occupy its sink rank, both use 12-by-12 RECTANGLE_PORT nodes, entry-point links bypass ordinary rank-same handling, and the visible cluster frontier is derived from normal interior boxes plus the border-point centers. Java lays out and paints root composites in group-declaration order even when transitions referenced those names earlier; every leaf of one root composite precedes every leaf of the next, and unpackaged root leaves follow the grouped leaves. During edge solving, each link adjusts only the last declaration-ordered border cluster among its group endpoints before compound clipping; all border clusters are adjusted later for painting.
causal_divergence: Java Entity.isAutarkic explicitly rejects groups containing non-normal leaves, so CucaDiagramSimplifierState leaves an entry/exit composite in the root GraphvizImageBuilder. ClusterDotString constructs source and sink ranks and, during declaration-ordered group traversal, repeatedly assigns projectionCluster to links touching each group, so the later endpoint wins. DotStringFactory.solve visits links in insertion order; SvekEdge.solveLine adjusts only that selected projection cluster immediately before DotPath.simulateCompound. Cluster.drawU adjusts every border frontier later. GraphvizImageBuilder.printGroups and printGroup also create each group's leaves together in Bibliotekon's LinkedHashMap, and SvekResult.drawU paints that order after all cluster chrome. Rust's first correction stable-partitioned a global solved order by diagram.states iteration, which is first-reference order for forward-declared composites, and eagerly adjusted every frontier before clipping every compound edge.
planned_change: Retain one or more entry/exit composites in the root LayoutGraph. Order those groups by the parser's explicit declaration line rather than first reference, then use that same order for cluster layout, chrome, and the stable leaf partition before unpackaged root leaves. Register basic-branch border leaves with PlantUML's 12-by-12 port-node geometry and source/sink constraints. Compute both original and FrontierCalculator-adjusted cluster rectangles; process links in insertion order, promoting only each link's last declaration-ordered group endpoint to its adjusted rectangle before compound clipping, and use adjusted rectangles for final painting. The wider-label plaintext HTML-port branch is a separate mechanism because the vendored Graphviz build has no Expat table parser.
perturbation_axes: declaration order plus varied labels that remain in the basic port branch
